Chapter 7021: I Believe So

Chapter 7021: I Believe So

“Fellow Daoists, excuse us for sending you on your way.” Golden Machine Immortal spoke.

“Worry not, you will wither away instantly, a painless death.” Autumn Wind said while increasing the domain’s power.

“I’m afraid your death will be far from painless.” Someone interrupted him.

“Who?!” Golden Machine Immortal looked over and saw an ordinary youth standing there.

He appeared to have been there the whole time without anyone noticing. This was akin to mortals not noticing ants on the ground.

“You?” Golden Machine Immortal’s expression changed.

Xiaolou Tingxue’s brows furrowed upon seeing Li Qiye.

“How dare you run your mouth?” Silver Machine Immortal didn’t recognize him.

“Today is your last day, regardless of who you are.” Autumn Wind said.

“The immortal is here!” Timeflow Lord was ecstatic to see Li Qiye.

“It’s him.” An immortal in the crowd recognized him: “He’s the one who killed Breaker Immortal...”

“What?” Those nearby stared at Li Qiye in disbelief.

“Bam!” Li Qiye walked forward and entered the withering domain.

“You destroyed Breaker Immortal’s branch?” Silver Machine Immortal didn’t buy it. How could a mortal do so?

Golden Machine Immortal, on the other hand, had seen Li Qiye destroy the crystal tile in Survivor Realm.

“I believe so.” Li Qiye said.

“Attack!” Immortal Bronze felt something was off and ordered.

“Very well.” The followers had no choice but to obey.

The withering domain erupted and surged toward Li Qiye. However, he waved his hand and grasped all of its power.

The oceanic withering force was condensed into a water drop, certainly harmless.

“Bam!” He crushed it and put an end to the domain, causing the controllers to stagger backward.

“This is terrible!” The allies wanted to run.

“Not so fast.” Li Qiye smiled and exerted his supreme will on them.

“Ahh!” The runners bellowed in pain, feeling as if invisible spears had pierced through their mouths.

They were utterly vulnerable and helpless before his gaze. A dozen or so couldn’t move an inch.

Neutral spectators couldn’t believe it while looking at immortals being skewered like fish.

“Mommy...” Wo Xiangsheng dropped to the ground.

Till Ancestor had experienced Li Qiye’s might personally, but now he realized Li Qiye had held back against him.

“This is...” Amethyst’s knees buckled.

“So powerful.” Timeflow murmured but wasn’t as shocked as the others.
